title: Responsible trade begins with transparent information.
intro: Hayked discusses sourcing, operational and documentation requirements directly with buyers and publishes specific claims only when supporting information is available.

principles.title: Transparent sourcing
principles.text: Keep source information connected to the coffee lot and the buyer requirement.

principles.title: Responsible operations
principles.text: Maintain clear operating records across preparation, storage and dispatch.

principles.title: Long-term relationships
principles.text: Build dependable communication with suppliers, service clients and international buyers.

principles.title: Verified reporting
principles.text: Share certifications, measurements and impact information only when current records support them.
